annotations.title: Remove the background from one photo (transparent PNG, signed)

description: Remove the background from ONE photo. Send the public https/http address of a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (10 MB at most, one photo per call, no lists); get back the same photo as a PNG with a soft transparent background (image_png_base64), the share of the picture that was kept, plain warnings when the cut looks doubtful, and a signed, dated record tying the result to the photo it came from. Free, no sign-up, 20 photos a day per caller. The result is returned in the answer and kept nowhere: save it yourself. The longest side of the result is at most 1600 px. Runs an open-weights segmentation model (BiRefNet, MIT licence) on LLPRO's own image worker. Public addresses only (ports 80 and 443); metadata (EXIF, location) is not carried into the result. It makes no promise that the cut is perfect: hair, glass, shadows and cluttered scenes can be wrong; look at the picture before you use it. For a listing, pass the result on to the Seller Agent (https://llpro.ai/seller-agent).
